description: This Java class provides utility methods for handling media control features specific to the car interface in an Android environment. It includes methods to validate car-related package names and to set slot reservation flags in a Bundle object to manage media control button reservations.

classes.name: CarHelper
classes.description: A utility class offering methods to support car media integration, such as validating package names and setting media slot reservation flags.

methods.name: isValidCarPackage
methods.description: Checks if the provided package name matches the designated car app package name.

methods.name: setSlotReservationFlags
methods.description: Configures slot reservation flags in a Bundle to reserve space for media control actions, such as skip previous, skip next, and queue.
